messages.content: Quick intro: I'm Max Turnquist, a robotics engineer.
I picked the violin back up this year and practice most evenings.
I adopted a cat named Biryani, a little tabby with opinions.
Palak paneer is my favorite food, total comfort dish.
I'm reading The Overstory by Richard Powers right now.
I ride a Cannondale Synapse road bike on weekends.
I'm learning Japanese before a trip to Kyoto in November.
Most weekends I go hiking in the foothills.
My coffee order is always a flat white.
My favorite movie is Arrival; I rewatch it constantly.
Radiohead is my favorite band by a mile.
I shoot photos with a Fujifilm X100V.
My go-to cocktail is a negroni.
I keep a fiddle-leaf fig in the living room.
I listen to the Lex Fridman podcast on commutes.
My sister Anita flew in to visit last week.
My parents, Deepak and Sunita, still live back in Portland.
My best friend Lena and I have known each other since school.
Anita and her husband Raj live in Chicago.
My manager at work, Priyanka, runs a tight ship.
My old college roommate Diego crashed on my couch last month.
My niece Mira just turned six.
My grad-school mentor was Professor Okafor.
Raj — my brother-in-law — is a cardiologist at a big hospital.
My best friend Lena works at Stripe and lives in San Francisco.
Anita is an architect and designed a library downtown.
Mira is Anita's daughter, so I spoil her rotten.
My manager Priyanka has been at Cobalt Robotics for a decade.
Professor Okafor taught robotics and still publishes constantly.
I'm finally settled in Denver after moving from Portland last spring.
I left Northwind Logistics in March and now work at Cobalt Robotics.
Cobalt has me leading the perception team now.
I switched from an iPhone to a Pixel a few months ago.
I used to play soccer but these days I train for marathons.
I got promoted to senior engineer at the last review.
I traded my old Civic for a Subaru Outback this year.
We moved out of our apartment into a small house in the spring.
I went vegetarian last year after decades of eating meat.
I recently got engaged to my partner Sam.
I climb at the Mesa Rim gym twice a week.
Autumn is hands down my favorite season.
I've been a Portland Trail Blazers fan my whole life.
